name: SwampFinance
fix_description: In deposit, claim/settle pending rewards before updating the user share. Currently rewards accumulated before a new deposit are distributed to the new depositor. Fix by calling the reward distribution/claim logic before modifying stake balances.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving a flash loan, Venus collateralization/borrowing, Belt vault deposit/withdraw, farming interaction, and strategy triggering before unwinding the position. It is not extremely long, but it requires understanding protocol-specific interactions across several contracts rather than exploiting a simple obvious bug.
